value.answer: There's no open Costco in Oakville yet. The closest open ones are in Burlington (1225 Brant St) and Mississauga (3180 Laird Rd). The first Oakville warehouse is targeted for fall 2027, on Wyecroft Road near Burloak Drive. Apple Maps showed the Burlington one closed today for Thanksgiving, so it may be shut today.
